description: This file contains unit tests for the silo role-based placement strategy in Orleans, verifying both failure and success scenarios for placing grains on silos with specific roles.

classes.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirectorTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing silo role-based placement strategy in Orleans.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CantFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that placing a grain on a non-existent silo role throws an OrleansException.

methods.name: SiloRoleBasedPlacementDirector_CanFindSilo
methods.description: Tests that a grain can be successfully placed on a silo with the specified role.
